items.title: Vibe-Coded Browser Ports Of Games Work Perfectly, Unfortunately
items.excerpt: Call of Duty: Black Ops, Halo: CE, GTA: Vice City, Skate 3 and more were decompiled and ported to web browsers overnight with AI coding agents, and they appear to run well.

items.title: PlayStation creator turned AI CEO Ken Kutaragi predicts AI daydreams will replace video games
items.excerpt: Ken Kutaragi told 4Gamer that real-time AI generation of video and music will run at console speed around 2028-29, turning 'imagination itself' into content and replacing games as we know them.

items.title: '여동생 운전 가르치기' 게임, AI 사용료만 하루 135만 원
items.excerpt: LLM 기반 스팀 게임 '여동생 운전 가르치기'가 데모 이용자 급증으로 하루 1,000달러에 달하는 AI 모델 사용료를 감당하지 못해 대출까지 받았고, 모델 전환으로 품질 저하 논란도 겪고 있다.

items.title: 크래프톤, 서울대와 게임·로봇 AI 월드모델 공동연구 시작
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 서울대학교와 게임·로봇 분야 월드모델 공동연구에 착수했다. 향후 3년간 공동연구센터를 운영하며 가상과 현실을 이해·예측하는 AI를 고도화한다.

items.title: [이슈] '사람 중심 축제'라더니...AGF, AI로 만든 티저 영상에 팬심 싸늘
items.excerpt: 애니메이션·게임 축제 AGF 2026 조직위가 공식 X 계정에 올린 티저 영상이 생성형 AI로 제작된 것으로 드러나 서브컬처 팬덤의 반발을 샀다.

items.title: AI 플루토, 놀라운 혁신인가 불공정한 체급 차이인가
items.excerpt: 스타크래프트1 전직 프로게이머와 ASL 정상급 선수들이 AI '플루토'에게 잇따라 패하면서, 30년 가까이 쌓인 인간 빌드 생태계를 흔드는 AI의 기괴한 운영과 컨트롤이 화제다.

items.title: 8일 출시 도깨비의 세계, 레트로 감성에 게임 플레이 돕는 AI 챗봇 '묘룡'
items.excerpt: 카카오게임즈가 슈퍼캣의 2.5D MMORPG '도깨비의 세계'를 8일 출시한다. 플레이를 돕는 인게임 AI 챗봇 '묘룡'을 핵심 특징으로 내세웠다.

items.title: An OpenAI model was caught trying to cheat at StarCraft, and of course it did it by stealing a human's work
items.excerpt: GPT-6 Astra tried to get a leg-up in Blizzard's RTS by pilfering a human-created bot.

items.title: Google Playground is an 'experimental' AI game platform
items.excerpt: Google has announced Google Playground, a Google Labs platform for making and playing games from gen-AI prompts, with Unity Spark as the pro on-ramp.

items.title: Dreamlands opens its AI 3D world-building platform to the public
items.excerpt: Dreamlands is publicly launching its 1.0 platform, giving anyone a way to generate game-ready 3D assets and entire worlds with AI.

items.title: A First Look at Unreal MCP in Unreal Engine 5.8
items.excerpt: Unreal Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an official, Epic-supported way to connect agentic LLM tools directly to Unreal Engine 5.8 so agents can take actions in projects via editor capabilities.

items.title: Official Unity Plugin for Grok Build Is Now Available
items.excerpt: The official Unity Plugin now works in xAI's Grok Build coding agent, adding 30+ Unity-written skills with one terminal command for Unity 6+.

items.title: PSVR Exclusive 'Astro Bot Rescue Mission' Running on Quest 3 is the Latest in VR Mod Explosion
items.excerpt: AI vibecoding has caused an explosion in VR modding; modder Bigmak94 has now brought PSVR exclusive Astro Bot Rescue Mission to Quest 3 and PC VR.

items.title: HelixSR Mod Brings DLSS 3.7 to the Steam Deck and AMD Handhelds, Running Faster Than FSR 4
items.excerpt: HelixSR is a new mod that enables DLSS 3.7 (Preset E) neural upscaling on Steam Deck and other AMD handhelds like the ROG Ally X.

items.title: Sony's PlayStation 5 QSSR May Lack the Shortcut That Made PSSR Easy, As Older Games Could Need a Later SDK
items.excerpt: Sony's QSSR AI upscaler on base PS5 may see limited adoption on legacy titles because it could require an SDK update rather than a drop-in swap.

items.title: Google and Unity unveil gen-AI game-making platforms, and demonstrate one of them with depressingly rubbish "dream game" Space Corridor
items.excerpt: Google now lets you create simple games with AI text prompts via Playground; Unity's engine will add text prompts and co-op creation through Unity Spark.
